description: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

lists.content:
• Build a deep understanding of Spotify’s label, publishing, lyrics, and audiobook contracts, how they’re implemented in our royalty systems, and how they flow into royalty calculations, downstream datasets, and reporting.
  • Use the team’s internal AI tooling to configure contracts in Spotify’s royalty systems and test financial outputs for accuracy before sign-off from Commercial Accounting.
  • Lead data analyses to answer royalty questions from internal teams such as Legal & Licensing and Finance, and from external partners such as rightsholders and back offices.
  • Support month-end royalty close by reviewing checks, validating calculation outputs, and escalating risks or issues.
  • Run month-end analytics, from generating the data and deck to providing commentary on fluxes, to support Content Accounting’s sign-off on final royalty figures.
  • Help build new capabilities for the team, contributing directly to how our internal AI tooling evolves as Spotify’s business grows.
  • Partner closely with Legal & Licensing, Commercial Accounting, Content Accounting, and Financial Engineering.

• You have a background in Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • You have 1+ years of experience in a data analyst or technical operations role. Experience in a royalty-related role at a record label, digital service provider, or music publisher is a plus.
  • You have strong technical and data analysis skills, such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • You bring an AI-first approach to problem-solving and are excited to get hands-on building and evolving internal tooling.
  • You’re curious about royalties and the music industry, and how Spotify pays the people who create content on our platform. Familiarity with label, publisher, or audiobook contracts, or with DSP data files, is a bonus.
  • You’re organized and flexible, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • You’re a coachable self-starter who enjoys learning new concepts and coordinating across teams to meet deadlines.
  • You’re detail-oriented with a high bar for accuracy, because our numbers drive real payouts to rightsholders.

This role is based in Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week.

  • Lead AV initiatives and projects with internal partners and external vendors, from defining scope through delivery, commissioning, and handover.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex AV issues and support incident, problem, and change management when needed.
  • Monitor AV infrastructure and performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and test new solutions that make collaboration easier for team members.
  • Deploy and support AI-powered capabilities across meeting rooms and video conferencing, while using AI tooling to improve areas such as monitoring, reporting, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain AV asset information, contribute to forecasting and budgeting, and create clear technical documentation and training materials.
  • Build strong relationships with vendors, integrators, and internal partners while identifying better ways of working across the team.

Experience configuring Q-SYS designs is a plus, as are certifications such as AVIXA CTS, Q-SYS Level 2, or Dante Level 3.

  • You communicate technical information clearly and create documentation that helps others understand, support, and use AV technology effectively.

  • You work effectively both independently and with distributed teams, communicate clearly with people across different roles and levels, and build trusted relationships with partners and vendors.
  • You take ownership of your work, adapt thoughtfully to changing priorities, and are motivated to keep learning as AV technology evolves.

• This role is based in Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  • We ask that you come in 4-5 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.
These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.
This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

lists.content:
• Build and Evolve Core Services: Design, build and operate the backend services and APIs behind our data catalog, lineage and publishing systems, and evolve them as the platform adopts new storage technologies and new kinds of data. Hold them to a high bar for correctness, performance and reliability.
  • Build Data Pipelines: Develop and run the batch and streaming pipelines that keep our metadata current, processing platform events and audit logs to capture how data is created and changed, and turning lineage and metadata into data products other teams build on.
  • Own Projects End to End: Turn what the teams using our platform need into technical designs, drive them through delivery and rollout, and own the results once they're in production.
  • Keep the Platform Healthy: Take part in on-call for critical services, build in observability and quality checks by default, and use automation, including AI tooling, to reduce toil for the team and our users.

• You have solid experience building and running backend services and APIs in production with Java, and you care about API design, versioning and backward compatibility.
  • You're comfortable with SQL and have worked with data pipelines or a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Databricks. Hands-on experience with batch or streaming frameworks like Beam, Flink or Spark is a plus.
  • You have a working understanding of data engineering concepts such as orchestration, metadata management, data quality, governance and lineage.
  • You break problems down into clear, shippable steps, reasoning through tradeoffs and risks and converging on clear recommendations.
  • You own the quality of what you ship, including code written with AI assistance, and you care about operating it well after launch.
  • You are a strong communicator and collaborator who enjoys working across teams, and you're comfortable in a dynamic platform environment where many engineers depend on what you build and priorities evolve with the business.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job.
The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next.
We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

lists.content:
• Build and evolve the lakehouse: Help build the foundations that let data workflows read and write Iceberg tables directly, from this cycle's MVP to a production-grade platform.
  • Drive adoption: Help migrate data pipelines from across Spotify onto the new stack, making the move as painless as possible through tooling, standards and hands-on support.
  • Own BigQuery at Spotify scale: Manage reservations and capacity, build monitoring and anti-pattern detection, and develop tooling like the BigQuery MCP server so teams can use BigQuery well.
  • Keep the platform healthy: Take part in a weekly support rotation and shared on-call. You'll debug production issues that span storage formats, catalog APIs, Kubernetes reconciliation, GCP IAM and BigQuery internals, and you'll automate away recurring toil.

• You have solid experience building and operating backend services in production with Java or Scala.
  • You're comfortable on GCP and Kubernetes. You can read kubectl output, reason about IAM and quotas, and work with CRDs and operators. You don't need deep expertise in all of these on day one.
  • You've worked with Apache Iceberg or JVM-based processing frameworks like Spark, Beam or Flink, or with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Databricks.
  • You think in systems and can connect the dots when a problem crosses several layers of the stack.
  • You like owning things in production, and you're motivated by seeing your systems run reliably for thousands of users.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and work well asynchronously across US and EU time zones.
  • You own the quality of what you ship, including code written with AI assistance.

This role is based in London or Stockholm.
 
We offer the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meeetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business.
The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do.


We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

lists.content:
• Lead and grow a team of machine learning, backend, and data engineers, supporting their development and helping them deliver their best work.Shape the team's technical strategy and execution, ensuring engineering efforts align with listener needs and Spotify's broader business goals.
  • Guide the development of machine learning and recommendation systems that balance multiple objectives across personalized listening experiences.
  • Collaborate with Product and engineering partners to define priorities, align on outcomes, and translate complex challenges into clear plans.
  • Support the team in making thoughtful technical decisions across experimentation, scalability, system reliability, and model performance.
  • Create a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel empowered to experiment and learn.
  • Drive effective planning and delivery while balancing immediate priorities with long-term technical health.
  • Foster an inclusive, supportive team environment through coaching, feedback, and thoughtful people leadership.

• You have experience managing and developing engineering teams, with a track record of helping people grow and delivering impactful results.
  • You bring a strong technical background in machine learning, software engineering, or related areas, and can confidently guide technical conversations.
  • You understand the opportunities and challenges of developing and operating machine learning systems in production.
  • You have experience working with cross-functional partners to define priorities, navigate trade-offs, and deliver against shared goals.
  • You are comfortable leading teams through ambiguity and helping engineers make informed technical decisions.
  • You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where people feel supported and empowered.
  • You communicate with clarity, lead with empathy, and know how to balance people, technology, and business needs

• This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

  • You care about creating engaging, rewarding, and valuable experiences for users, creators, and Spotify

descriptionPlain:
We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it.
As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.
description:
We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it.

As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

lists.content:
• Own the monthly and quarterly close for your areas, delivering accurate IFRS results and clear, insight-driven flux commentary
  • Use AI tools and data (BigQuery, SQL, LLM-based assistants) to automate preparation, speed up analysis, and redirect time toward review and judgment
  • Design, build, and maintain lightweight automations and AI-assisted workflows, and partner with Financial Engineering on larger system changes
  • Make sure automated and AI-assisted processes stay accurate, explainable, and well-controlled, including SOX controls and audit evidence
  • Act as a go-to partner for FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement, AP, and business teams, turning ad hoc requests into scalable, self-serve solutions
  • Support external and internal audits for your areas and keep RTR processes and documentation current
  • Share knowledge and coach teammates on both accounting and new ways of working

• You have 4+ years of month-end close or general ledger experience at a global, publicly traded company, with solid IFRS knowledge
  • You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; a CPA or equivalent is a plus
  • You bring strong accounting judgment and can research and resolve accounting questions independently
  • You’re comfortable working directly with data; experience with SQL and BigQuery is strongly preferred, or you have a clear willingness to learn quickly
  • You have hands-on experience using AI tools to improve your work, or strong curiosity to start, plus the judgment to know when not to trust the output
  • You have an automation mindset: you notice repetitive work and want to remove it
  • You understand upstream and downstream processes (AP, Procurement, Treasury) and how they affect the general ledger
  • You have experience with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred; Oracle or SAP also relevant)
  • You’re a clear communicator who can explain accounting and data topics to non-specialists and keep priorities on track during close

This role is based in Stockholm.

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 x per week.

descriptionPlain:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 
Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.
description:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 

Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

lists.content:
• Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.
  • Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.
  • Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.
  • Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.
  • Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.

• You have strong proficiency in C++, along with experience building native iOS applications in Swift, or you're excited to develop your expertise in Swift while applying your C++ skills.
  • You have experience designing, building, or maintaining security-sensitive systems such as authorization, authentication, token management, credential storage, or related platforms.
  • You bring a systems-thinking mindset and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that span client and backend technologies.
  • You have a solid understanding of software architecture, secure system design, and modern authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0.
  • You approach problems thoughtfully, with strong attention to detail and a focus on building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with engineers across multiple teams and technical disciplines.
  • You have experience working with shared cross-platform codebases and understand how native platform layers interact with common C++ libraries.
  • You enjoy working on large-scale distributed systems where your contributions improve experiences for hundreds of millions of Spotify users.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
We are currently looking for a new band member to join the Spotify Tax Team. This new band member will be an Analyst, joining the Global Indirect Tax Team. This position will report into the Senior Manager for Indirect Tax in EMEA and APAC and will be based in Stockholm, Sweden.
In your role, you will focus on compliance and reporting. Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams.
We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

In your role, you will focus on compliance and reporting. Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams.

We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

lists.content:
• Prepare indirect tax returns ensuring they are filed timely and accurate.
  • Calculate indirect taxes and ensure timely payments.
  • Analyze data and transactions to ensure correct reporting.
  • Assist with gathering and analyzing data for indirect tax audits and internal audits.
  • Support in monitoring Indirect Tax rules and regulations all over the world.
  • Coordinate with, and support, Finance and Accounting teams as necessary and assist in processes that involve indirect tax.
  • Assist with new tax registrations where needed.
  • Work with external service providers and foreign tax authorities.
  • Participate in process improvement projects
  • Assist in other tax compliance areas such as digital services tax.
  • Other projects as required.

• University degree with relevant education such as law degree, accounting, CPA, or any combination thereof.
  • Approximately 2 years of relevant tax related work experience.
  • Experience from indirect tax compliance work on a global scale is a big plus.
  • Excellent English skills, both verbally and written. Other language skills are helpful.
  • Experience with financial systems (we use NetSuite): ERPs, consolidation tools and management reporting tools.
  • Strong skills in the Google suite and/or Microsoft Office including the ability to prepare robust models and the ability and desire to learn new software platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to drive work and assist with process improvements.
  • Self-starter, capable of working independently with strong initiative and flexibility.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency and quality in day-to-day work, with a willingness to explore new ways of applying them. 
  • Intellectually curious, detail oriented, and eager to learn and develop every day.
  • Able to work in a fast paced, informal, and often ambiguous environment.

• This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! We ask that you come to the office at least 3 times a week.

description: We’re looking for a Tax Manager to join Spotify’s Global Transfer Pricing team, reporting to the Director of Global Transfer Pricing. In this role you’ll focus on analytics, modelling and AI. You’ll drive the development of Spotify’s global transfer pricing models and economic analyses, keeping our intercompany pricing accurate, efficient and defensible in every jurisdiction where we operate. You’ll also help lead the team’s use of AI tools and automation to change how transfer pricing work gets done, from forecasting and projections to audit support. You’ll join a team of skilled, dedicated colleagues in a fast-moving international company, with plenty of room to take on responsibility. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

lists.content:
• Develop, maintain and continuously improve Spotify’s global transfer pricing models for quarter-end and year-end closes.
  • Prepare and review quarterly and annual transfer pricing calculations, delivering them within internal and reporting deadlines.
  • Turn externally prepared benchmarking studies and economic analyses into practical inputs for our transfer pricing models.
  • Partner with FP&A and finance business partners on future transfer pricing outcomes and projections.
  • Drive the adoption of AI tools and automation to make transfer pricing processes more efficient, accurate and scalable.
  • Work with Spotify’s data and technology teams to transform how financial data for transfer pricing transactions is sourced and handled.
  • Collaborate with Tax, Treasury, Accounting and Legal on transfer pricing matters, and support tax audits with documentation, analyses and outcome scenarios.
  • Contribute to transfer pricing documentation, including local files and master files.

• You have 5+ years of experience in transfer pricing, gained at a Big 4 firm, in industry, or both. Experience in the tech industry is a plus.
  • You hold a degree in accounting, finance, economics, business administration or law.
  • You have hands-on transfer pricing operations experience, including model-building, economic analysis, valuation analysis and benchmarking.
  • You have strong analytical and quantitative skills and can build and maintain complex financial models in Google Sheets or Excel. Experience with SQL, Python or other data tools is a strong plus.
  • You’ve worked with financial systems such as ERP, consolidation and management reporting tools. Knowledge of NetSuite is a plus.
  • You use AI tools to improve efficiency and quality in your daily work, and you’re curious about new ways to apply them.
  • You have supported the transfer pricing aspects of tax audits and prepared defence files.
  • You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken, and you’ve worked well in cross-functional, cross-border teams.
  • You’re intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable in a fast-paced, informal and often ambiguous environment.

• This role is based in Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week.
